title: chat composer: a file over maxFileSize is refused with only a console.warn, so the user sees the file silently not attach
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① reproducible defect, read from code (not measured in a browser), on main before PR #34459. Named by L1-b record 6928835635 on PR #34459.

## Symptom

In the chat composer (used by the console AI chat), a picked, pasted or dropped file over `maxFileSize` (default 10 MiB) is refused with only a `console.warn`. The user sees nothing: the file just does not attach, with no reason given.

## Location

The prompt-input composer in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` (the `maxFileSize` check on attach).

## Acceptance

1. A refused file shows the user a visible, translated message naming the file and the size limit.
2. Pins: an over-size file shows the message and is not attached; CONTROL: a file under the limit attaches with no message.

## Related

#32749, PR #34459 (Acceptance notes).

Dedupe: searched open issues on 2026-11-16 for `composer maxFileSize console.warn` (1 hit: #32749) and `chat attachment too large silent` (6 hits, all PM seat posts); none reports this.
